coverage_assessment: First-pass open-web research has 41 saved response records and 760 aligned headers, including exact recovery of three previously uncaptured original responses and 30 omitted headers from seven partial records; no new search was run for this repair. Coverage spans generic, German and English searches, weekly February windows, Austrian regional/local and sector leads, event-detail follow-ups, and January/next-month boundary checks. One three-term invocation remains at invocation scope because the tool did not partition returned headers by query. This is not an exhaustive sweep or an absence finding. The official baseline and eligibility, episode, target and threshold decisions remain pending coordinator review.
